bear.last: RKLB: RKLB is trading at $53.04, well below its 20‑day SMA ($65.53), 50‑day SMA ($67.48) and 200‑day SMA ($80.91), confirming a strong downtrend. The upcoming Q3 2026 earnings on 2026‑11‑09 present a gap‑risk event; a miss would likely trigger a sharp sell‑off given the already fragile price action.
